Aisha (runtime): Quick async: doing a short scrub of warmup/kv-latency items before tomorrow's sync. TL;DR: two ownership gaps + one infra blocker.
Mateo: thanks — can you list the ownership gaps?
Aisha (runtime): 1) kernel-side eviction tuning (who owns the heuristics table?) 2) prefetch handshake in continuous-batch (ownership overlap between kernel and kvcache).
Priya: I own the heuristics table work but FYI I'm on PTO tomorrow morning; I can PR the simple threshold change today.
Dan: for prefetch handshake, eng-platform started the proto; runtime needs to accept new header. I'm happy to partner.
Linh: infra-bot flagged a node image roll that may reset KV warmup state — rolling to prod tonight at 02:00 UTC. That's the infra blocker.
Aisha (runtime): ack. Impact: if image roll happens mid-canary we lose prefix warmup -> latency spike ~30-120s for affected hosts. We need either: a) drain before roll, or b) rely on fast re-warm strategy.
Mateo: can we add a fast warm path? Summary of options off the top: 1) persist minimal KV working set to disk on reboot 2) aggressive parallel prefetch on startup 3) fallback to smaller model variant for 1m.
Priya: 1) requires disk format and corruption handling — nontrivial. 2) we have a warm-preload PR (https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/392) that parallelizes prefix loads, but it's behind a feature flag. 3) fallback needs routing config change in smart-router.
Dan: infra can delay the image roll by 2 hours if runtime teams want a hard window to inject mitigation. Not ideal but possible.
Aisha (runtime): proposed near-term plan: a) enable warm-preload feature flag for canary tomorrow, b) Priya to cut the PR today and I will flip flag in canary at 03:10 UTC after smoke, c) Dan/infra to hold roll until 06:00 UTC (2-hr cushion). Long-term: persist state + handshake.
Priya: I'll finish the PR and add test notes. ETA: EOD PT (in ~6h).
Mateo: I'll prepare a quick router fallback patch to route 10% to smaller model for 5m in case we still see a flare. Patch will be link in this thread when ready.
Linh: confirming infra will hold roll until 06:00 UTC. I'll add a maintenance note and a slack alert 15m before the roll. infra-bot: scheduled image-roll on prod at 2025-04-17T06:00:00Z (was 02:00:00Z) :white_check_mark:
Aisha (runtime): outstanding ownership clarifications: - kernel eviction heuristics -> Priya (with Mateo as reviewer) - prefetch handshake integration -> Dan + Aisha (runtime) - router fallback -> Mateo - infra scheduling -> Linh
Dan: noted — I'll open a tiny integration PR that wires the new header acceptance; aiming for a canary-only change with a feature flag.
Mateo: PR: https://github.com/redwood/router/pull/1100 (draft) — will add traffic rule and rollback playbook.
Aisha (runtime): test checklist before I flip warm-preload flag on canary: `curl -X POST $CANARY/admin/prime?prefix=abc123` -> confirm KV entries appear in /var/run/kvcache metrics, check `kvcache.warmup.seconds < 10` in telemetry.
Priya: added unit tests + a small e2e that uses mocked disk snapshot. Test logs: ```
[INFO] warm-preload: started 3 workers
[INFO] warm-preload: prefix loaded (count=42, seconds=0.8)
```
Linh: I'll wire a smoke alert to #eng-runtime for 03:15 UTC run. If any error > 5% we pause.
Aisha (runtime): final ask: if owners can post short sign-offs here once their PRs are open/flag flipped/roll postponed. I'll summarize in tomorrow's sync notes. Thanks all :rocket:
Mateo: will post when router patch is ready.
Priya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/392 — marking owner: Priya.
Dan: integration PR created: https://github.com/redwood/platform/pull/802 — will coordinate test with Aisha.
Linh: infra-bot: image-roll postponed to 2025-04-17T06:00:00Z ; slack alert scheduled.
Aisha (runtime): sign-off: warm-preload flag will be flipped in canary after smoke at 03:10 UTC if metrics look good. I'll ping here when flipped.
infra-bot: deploy pipeline: canary smoke passed :thumbsup: (03:07 UTC)
Aisha (runtime): flipped flag on canary. Observability note: watching `kvcache.collisions` and `rpc.latency.p95`. If anyone sees >10% p95 increase tag me.
Mateo: router patch live to staging; will promote to prod if warm path stable.
Priya: all green on unit + e2e in CI.
Dan: integration smoke OK from my side.
Aisha (runtime): thanks everyone — I'll post a brief recap in the sync doc and close the loop after the roll window.
